title: Curated MEDA environmental context windows (educational)
source_paper: The diverse meteorology of Jezero crater over the first 250 sols of Perseverance on Mars

units.optical_depth: dimensionless aerosol optical depth (published seasonal range)
units.note: Windows use published early-mission dust OD context (approx. 0.3–0.6; morning OD often ~0.5). Not a raw PDS CSV sol extract.

windows.label: Window A — elevated morning opacity context
windows.planning_note: Morning opacity often higher in the clear-season cycle described in the source paper.

windows.label: Window B — lower / calmer dust OD interval
windows.planning_note: Within the published low dust OD range (0.3–0.6) toward the clearer end.

windows.label: Window C — upper-range dust OD context
windows.planning_note: Near the upper end of the published early-mission dust OD range.
